decision_conditions: <p>All the conditions applicable to the original permission 16/P0112 apart from condition 2 of that permission are applicable to this permission.</p><p>Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.&nbsp;</p>
description: APPLICATION FOR VARIATION OF CONDITION 2 (APPROVED PLANS), ATTACHED TO LBM PLANNING APPLICATION 16/P0112 RELATING TO THE 25/P0425 CHANGES RELATE TO  CONVERSION OF FLATS INTO SINGLE DWELLINGHOUSE INCORPORATING PART SINGLE STOREY REAR AND PART TWO STOREY REAR SIDE EXTENSIONS, EXTENSION OF EXISTING BASEMENT, NEW FRONT PORCH CANOPY, REPLACEMENT FRONT AND REAR DORMERS AND INTERNAL ALTERATIONS.
